title: First-run walkthrough + pricing calibration screenshot pack for model catalog release
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Deliver a set of high-fidelity screenshots and lightweight micro-interaction assets for the model catalog release notes. This ticket covers: (1) a 'first-run' mini walkthrough that surfaces pricing context when users discover a new model, (2) a pricing calibration overlay demonstrating per-token vs. subscription pricing toggles, (3) deprecation badges and timeline states for models being sunset, and (4) localized price formats (USD, EUR, GBP) for the quickstart experience. Output should include three breakpoint variants (desktop/compact/tablet) and annotated copy for release notes and the docs quickstart. Assets will be used in the release blog, console release banner, and onboarding email screenshots.
updates: 2026-03-12: Initial brief accepted by PM (Marcos Rivera). Scope: 6 screenshots + 3 micro-GIFs. Confirmed localization requirement for EUR and GBP.
2026-03-13: Wireframes completed. Decided to combine per-token price slider with a short explainer tooltip rather than a full modal to reduce friction (decision from design review).
2026-03-14: Eng (Lina Zhou) flagged that pricing toggle API changes are targeted for 2026-03-19; placeholder data will be used for screenshots until feature branch lands. Added dependency ENG-5392.
2026-03-15: First visual pass uploaded to Figma. Requested PM copy updates for the walkthrough step 2 (clarify 'burst capacity' language). Assigned visual QA for 2026-03-18.
2026-03-15: Added alternate 'compact tile' variant for mobile that hides the price slider and surfaces a single CTA with inline price tag for A/B testing.
design_decisions: Use a short inline walkthrough (3 steps) anchored to the catalog header for lower entry friction on first-run.
Pricing calibration should show both per-token estimates and equivalent monthly subscription cost where applicable; show both values side-by-side for clarity.
Deprecation ribbon uses high-contrast 'Sunset' orange with an info tooltip linking to migration docs. Include an archived state for deprecated models with disabled 'Try' CTA.
For localization, format currencies using locale-aware separators and place currency symbol before amount for USD/GBP, after for EUR as per our localization guidelines.
review_feedback: PM Marcos Rivera: 'Tone on the walkthrough should emphasize SLO impact and cost predictability; tweak copy to mention 'latency tiers' instead of 'performance tiers'.
Eng Lina Zhou: 'Make sure screenshots for the price slider include example latencies pulled from the runtime team (see ENG-5392). Use placeholder '50ms' for now.'
Design Director Priya Menon: 'Prefer the compact tile variant for the email screenshots; reduce visual weight of badges to improve scanability.'
Accessibility Reviewer Omar Khatri: 'Ensure contrast ratio for price text passes 4.5:1 and interactive hotspots are at least 44x44px.'

notes: Deliver final JPG/PNG + annotated PNG with callouts for docs team.
Include copy snippets for release notes (short + long) in the Figma file's 'Text' layer.
